repairs.title: Trusted/untrusted process separation
requirements: Trusted parent MUST NOT import candidate modules.
Candidate-controlled execution MUST NOT share mutable trusted result-accounting state.
Candidate stdout, JSON, exit code, or in-process result object MUST NOT alone authorize PASS.
Qualification-contributing accounting MUST originate from the trusted parent and remain evidence-only until independent review.

repairs.title: Actual interpreter/runtime startup verification
requirements: Trusted orchestration MUST verify actual interpreter flags before candidate bytes are importable.
isolated, no_site, ignore_environment, and safe_path MUST be true or execution fails closed.
Exact Python runtime identity/version used for stdlib-shadow policy MUST be bound to the execution record.
Pinset declarations MUST NOT substitute for actual runtime verification.

repairs.title: Executed adversarial-check evidence binding
requirements: Each mandatory check MUST bind an executed evidence record.

Each record MUST bind exact check ID, candidate commit/tree, environment, interpreter contract, run/round identity, evidence digest, terminal state/result, and independent witness identity/control domain.
Missing, duplicate, stale, mismatched, unexecuted, self-witnessed, or name-only records MUST fail closed.
The aggregate binding digest MUST commit to exact evidence-record digests, not check names alone.

repairs.title: Authority-origin evidence hardening
requirements: Package colocation MUST NOT be treated as proof of repository authorization.
External authority objects MUST bind their exact repository identities and remain absent from the frozen candidate.
Authority-origin evidence remains challengeable evidence and cannot self-grant qualification.

mandatory_adversarial_targets: candidate forges stdout or structured result payload
runner runtime version differs from bound stdlib-shadow policy version
mandatory adversarial check supplied by name only
mandatory adversarial evidence stale candidate binding
mandatory adversarial evidence duplicate or missing check
